_note: RKF L0 adapter registry. ingest.py iterates this list to pick an adapter by detector; adding a format or source = append a row, no code change. 'emitter' is 'module:function' resolved dynamically; 'status' marks whether the emitter is wired yet.

adapters.note: ebooklib spine+NCX/nav; keeps chapter order, TOC titles, heading tree, per-doc metrics.
PyMuPDF per-page text + doc TOC; born-digital PDFs. Scanned PDFs -> see file-pdf-hifi (DEFER).
plain text / markdown as a single-chapter IR.
Office/archive/tabular -> flat markdown via markitdown. Fallback front door when no structured adapter owns the format.
images (OCR/EXIF) + audio (transcription). Needs OCR/STT extras; P4. OCR-from-image only surfaces facts, still summarize-only for commits.
URL -> clean main text + provenance (source_url). Body stays in gitignored corpus/; commits only summaries/short quotes.
Enrich L1 meta (publisher, pages, cover link, subjects). Never fetches body text.
License-gated; append and wire only when a scanned/figure-dense PDF actually appears (S4 fission signal).
